result.notes: Third-party service (not YouTube/Google official) that wraps YouTube transcript extraction as a REST API. Bearer-token auth confirmed via OpenAPI spec and live 401 probe (WWW-Authenticate: Bearer). Free self-serve tier: 100 credits, no card required, then paid credit-based plans ($5/mo for 1000 credits). Small API surface (~9 endpoints, all YouTube-scoped: transcript, info, search, channel, playlist). Vendor claims first-party MCP server at transcriptapi.com/mcp (gated by same bearer auth, per 401 response) plus "agent skills" — labeled official since vendor-hosted and vendor-published, though not independently verified against a public MCP registry (mcp_registry lookup returned none). Composio also wraps this as a toolkit (api_key auth, 9 tools), consistent with findings.
result.one_liner: Third-party API (transcriptapi.com) for fetching YouTube video transcripts, metadata, search, channel and playlist data.
